CustomField.label: Passed Checks
CustomField.description: Controls what happens to checks that PASS. Show each check keeps them listed. Hide checks, show count only removes the passed checks from the list; their count still appears in the summary bar at the bottom of the card.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Show each check = list every passed check. Hide checks, show count only = remove passed checks from the list; the count still shows in the summary bar.
